newsitem.title: UK: MEPC considers 2.0 bln stg break-up - paper.
newsitem.headline: MEPC considers 2.0 bln stg break-up - paper.

text.p: MEPC Plc has launched a radical restructuring plan which could lead to the break-up of the 2.0 billion pound ($3.2 billion) British property group, said The Sunday Telegraph newspaper.
The paper said that chief executive James Tuckey was examining proposals to spin off MEPC's small properties division, valued at 350 million pounds, "as the first in a series of demergers."

It said the company was also prepared to float off its 700 million pound U.S. business as a separately-listed real estate investment trust and float its Australian division, valued at 400 million pounds.
Last week MEPC's shares rose on a report that rival Hammerson Plc might be preparing to make a takeover bid.
The two ended previous merger talks earlier this month.
